name: 19939-batchdecode-qwen3vl30ba3b-dp8
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct, bf16 and unquantized. NOT SUBSTITUTED. The workload is text only, so the vision tower is loaded and never executed.
parallelism: TP=8 with data-parallel attention at DP=8, so attn_tp_size = 1: each rank runs the whole attention for its own eighth of the batch while the MoE stays tensor-parallel across all eight. No expert parallelism, no all-to-all MoE backend, PP=1, one node. dp_size == tp_size == 8 is part of the declared setup, not a tuning choice.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 2048 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. 64 streams over 8 DP ranks is 8 tokens per rank per decode step.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix and no reuse between requests: about 1024 prompt tokens in and about 1024 generated tokens out, each drawn with stdev 128 and clamped to [640, 1408]. temperature 0.0. Text only.
purpose: A text chat assistant on a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, serving 64 concurrent thousand-token turns across eight GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id:`.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- this file is read line by line and an indented line is DROPPED, so a
# nested block would silently never reach the engine. host / port / served-model-name are owned
# by the serving layer and do not belong here.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct

# Eight GPUs of one node. `tp-size` is the world size and `dp-size` splits attention inside it,
# so with the two EQUAL there are eight ranks at attn_tp_size = 1. The equality is part of the
# declaration: at dp_size < tp_size, and at dp_size == 1, the engine lays out its per-layer
# tensors differently and this is no longer the same setup. Do not add `--ep-size` or any
# `--moe-a2a-backend` either -- both hand the experts their tokens by a different mechanism.
tp-size: 8
dp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true

# Pinned rather than derived, so no device-memory probe and no checkpoint-shape heuristic
# decides the KV pool or the captured graph ladder. With DP attention the engine divides the
# chunk size by dp_size, so 8192 here means the server runs at 1024.
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
cuda-graph-max-bs: 128
mem-fraction-static: 0.75

random-seed: 0
